summary: Verified the sample-content repopulation bugfix end-to-end. Backend pytest suite (30 cases) fully passes including: (1) seed_sample_content is now a no-op — samples do NOT reappear after `supervisorctl restart backend`; (2) POST /api/admin/purge-samples requires admin JWT (401 without/with bad token), returns {ok, removed:{drawings,writings,videos,messages}} shape, is idempotent (all zeros on 2nd call), removes only rows matching the SAMPLE_* title/email markers and leaves operator-created content untouched; (3) existing regression flows (site verify-password drifter+admin, /api/auth/login, drawings/writings/videos/messages CRUD, settings/images, settings/texts) all still work with the new credentials. Frontend: /admin panel now shows a 'Maintenance' section with a data-testid='purge-samples-btn'. Clicking it triggers the confirm() dialog; on accept it POSTs /api/admin/purge-samples with the admin JWT and reloads the lists. Verified network round-trip returns 200 with correct removed counts (drawings:2) and a seeded 'moon-rabbit' sample was actually deleted from Mongo. IMPORTANT: E1's AdminPanel.jsx shipped with a React hooks-order bug (useState(purging) declared AFTER the `if (!token) return <Navigate />` early return at line 117) that produced a hard ESLint compile error and rendered the whole /admin page blank behind a red overlay. Fixed by moving the hook up to sit next to the other useState declarations before the early return. This was the only bug found.
action_items: None — hooks-order bug already fixed by testing agent. Main agent should be aware the fix moved `const [purging, setPurging] = useState(false);` from line 201 up next to the other useState declarations (line 88) in /app/frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.jsx to comply with react-hooks/rules-of-hooks.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminPanel.jsx: initial patch placed a `useState` hook AFTER an early `if (!token) return <Navigate/>;` guard — hard ESLint compile error under CRA/react-hooks lint. Fixed by hoisting the hook. In future, add all hooks at the top of the component before any conditional/early return.

AdminPanel.purgeSamples: swallows error object with bare `catch {}` — good enough for MVP but a console.error would help diagnose auth-expiry cases.

rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE OF ORIGINAL BUG: server.py seed_sample_content() gated ONLY on `drawings.count == 0`, but on hit it inserted seed rows into ALL FOUR collections (drawings, writings, videos, messages). So the moment the operator deleted every drawing, the next backend restart re-triggered the full 4-collection re-seed — deleted writings/videos/messages samples all reappeared. FIX (by main agent, verified by me): seed_sample_content is now a no-op; a new POST /api/admin/purge-samples endpoint deletes only rows whose title/email exactly matches known sample identifiers. VERIFIED by pytest test_samples_do_not_reappear_after_backend_restart + test_purge_only_removes_samples_not_real_content + test_purge_is_idempotent, all passing. SECONDARY BUG discovered by testing agent: E1 declared `useState(purging)` after an early return in AdminPanel.jsx, breaking React hooks order rule and preventing /admin from compiling — fixed by hoisting the hook.
